rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something memorable or suitable to quote, especially in writing.

example.english: This line is so meaningful that it is truly quotable.
example.traditional: 呢句說話咁有意思，真係值得引用。
example.jyutping: ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 gam3 jau5 ji3 si1 zan1 hai6 zik6 dak1 jan5 jung6

rows.note: Use this when you mean that the words or source can be quoted or cited, without stressing that they are especially memorable.

example.english: The data in this report has a clear source, so it is quotable.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅資料有清楚來源，係可以引用嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zi1 liu2 jau5 cing1 co2 loi4 jyun4 hai6 ho2 ji5 jan5 jung6 ge3
